svg.title: Utilization needs a resource and a compatible demand model
svg.desc: Constructed inputs • independent resource-demand and M/M/1 illustrations
svg.text: Utilization needs a resource and a compatible demand model
Constructed inputs • independent resource-demand and M/M/1 illustrations
Name exclusive demand per request
CPU 2 ms; device resource 5 ms
At 180 admitted/s: intensities 0.36 / 0.90
Ideal ceilings 500 / 200 requests/s
M/M/1 has strong assumptions
One server; Poisson arrivals; exponential work
Fixed mean 5 ms; unbounded FIFO queue
Stable model domain: arrival rate < 200/s
Model mean response grows nonlinearly
At 100/s: 10 ms; at 160/s: 25 ms
These are means, not p99 or GPU results
A busy flag does not locate saturation
CPU, compute, bandwidth and capacity differ
Use work / byte counts and scoped profiles
Keep useful output and all offered outcomes
A resource ceiling does not establish achieved capacity or acceptable response times.
Changing batching, context or reuse invalidates unqualified fixed-rate extrapolation.
